title: 第154章 接顾承礼放学
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

宋禾等人接受检验进入府城，还是和上次一样，先找了个地方住下。

其实这次宋禾拿了钱，预备着直接在府城买个院子来放货，以后把从下邳村把布都运院子里，到时候她就在府城跑销路。

第二日，玉桃是被窗外的吵闹声惊醒的，等她醒来时，发现原本和自己在同一个房间的东家已经不见了。

玉桃先是慌张了几秒，迅速穿戴好下床，她想直接出门去找东家，但手放在门上又不敢推开。

东家说过，不让自己乱跑。

另一侧，窗户热闹的吆喝声再次传来。

玉桃慢慢的走到窗户面前。

“卖包子喽，卖包子喽，肉馅素馅糖馅什么都有喽。”

“卖包子喽，刚出锅的热腾大包子……”

玉桃伸手

下方是一条长长的街道，一眼望不掉头，街道两旁全是铺子，高低落错的旗幌立在铺子前，街上有吆喝叫卖的小贩，有表演杂耍的手艺人，有肩上扛着小孩买东西的客人……

玉桃站在客栈二楼，呆呆的看着眼前热闹的一幕，嘴角渐渐勾起一个弧度。

原来，这就是广平府。

“府城很热闹吧。”

推门声伴着宋禾的声音响起，玉桃猛然的回头，看见宋禾手里提着水壶走进来。

“东家。”玉桃连忙走回去，接过水壶。

宋禾笑着道：“洗把脸，等一下吃过饭，我带你出去逛逛。”

吃完早饭，宋禾和顾新礼带着玉桃出门。

王栓子和郑碾两个人留在客栈看货。

顾新礼道：“咱们还是去找上次的牙行？”

宋禾点头，“对。”

玉桃跟在宋禾身边，看着宋禾和顾家二哥找到一个牙行。

玉桃看着宋禾和陌生的房牙交谈，之后又跟着房牙去看院子，几个人上午就走了三个地方，中午在街边小摊上吃面条。

玉桃原本想说自己可以忍着不吃，等回客栈之后吃干粮，但宋禾还是给玉桃要了一碗，并嘱咐她一定得吃完。

玉桃低头吃面，觉得这是自己吃过最好吃的面条。

下午几个又走了四个院子，宋禾相中了两个，一个是靠街边的商铺，商铺后面带着个小院，但宋禾去的时候发现商铺的位置有些偏，地理位置不是很好。

另一个，则是由一进院子，改成的小二进房，这样一改里面房子虽然看起来有些小，但屋子够多，而且还有口水井，一进的院里正好还能放马。

思考片刻，宋禾决定要小院子。

“劳烦，再带我们去刚刚的小院走一趟。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Song He and others accepted the test and entered Fucheng. Just like last time, they first found a place to stay.

In fact, this time Song He took the money and planned to buy a yard directly in Fucheng to store goods. Later, she would transport the cloth from Xiapi Village to the yard, and then she would sell it in Fucheng.

The next day, Yu Tao was awakened by the noise outside the window. When she woke up, she found that her boss who was in the same room with her had disappeared.

Yutao panicked for a few seconds, then quickly dressed and got out of bed. She wanted to go out directly to find her employer, but she put her hand on the door and didn't dare to push it open.

My boss said, don't let yourself run around.

On the other side, the lively shouting came from the window again.

Yu Tao slowly walked to the window.

"I sell steamed buns. I sell steamed buns with everything from meat fillings to plain fillings and sugar fillings."

"I'm selling steamed buns, hot steamed buns just out of the pan..."

Jade Tao reaches out

Below is a long street, you can't turn around at a glance. There are shops on both sides of the street. Flags of different heights stand in front of the shops. On the street, there are vendors shouting and selling, craftsmen performing jugglers, and customers carrying children on their shoulders to buy things...

Yutao stood on the second floor of the inn, staring blankly at the lively scene in front of her, and the corners of her mouth gradually curved.

It turns out that this is Guangping Mansion.

"Fucheng is very lively."

The sound of pushing the door was accompanied by Song He's voice. Yu Tao suddenly turned around and saw Song He walking in with a kettle in his hand.

"Master." Yutao walked back quickly and took the kettle.

Song He smiled and said, "Wash your face. After dinner, I will take you out for a walk."

After breakfast, Song He and Gu Xinli took Yu Tao out.

Wang Shuanzi and Zheng Nian stayed at the inn to look at the goods.

Gu Xinli said: "Should we go to the dental shop from last time?"

Song He nodded, "Yes."

Yutao followed Song He and watched Song He and the second brother of the Gu family find a tooth shop.

Yutao watched Song He talking to the unfamiliar Fang Ya, and then followed Fang Ya to see the yard. They walked to three places in the morning and ate noodles at a street stall at noon.

Yutao originally wanted to say that she could hold back and eat dry food after returning to the inn, but Song He still ordered a bowl for Yutao and told her to finish it.

Yutao lowered his head to eat the noodles, feeling that this was the most delicious noodles he had ever eaten.

In the afternoon, they visited four more courtyards. Song He chose two. One was a shop on the street with a small courtyard behind the shop. However, when Song He went there, he found that the location of the shop was a bit off and the location was not very good.

The other one was converted from the first entrance into the courtyard into the second entrance room. Although the house inside looks a bit small, there are enough rooms and there is a well. The first courtyard can be used for horses.

After thinking for a moment, Song He decided to have a small courtyard.

"Excuse me, please take us to the small courtyard just now."
